title: Structured reason: code + subcode + actor

problem.silent_control_events: A's 13 RESUMED and 11 PAUSED events all had an empty reason message, so why a project stopped could not be read from the event at all
problem.hidden_decision_field: r517's decisive value (REOPEN_REVISION_TEXT) lived in a payload field OUTSIDE the envelope, so reason.code could not distinguish a text revision from any other reopen - audit finding X-01

design.canonical_code_unchanged: code remains the stable discriminator; no new top-level event type is introduced for a subtype
design.subcode: the finer distinction, e.g. PAUSED/OPERATOR, PAUSED/DEADLINE, PAUSED/EXECUTION_SCOPE, PAUSED/FREEZE_BOUNDARY, RESUMED/OPERATOR, RESUMED/RETRY, RESUMED/AUTO_RECOVERY
design.actor: who caused it: operator | engine | scheduler
design.additive: both fields default to empty, so events written before S4.1 keep their shape and stay readable (asserted)
design.final_decision_lift: normalize_reason now lifts payload['final_decision'] into subcode when no explicit subcode is given, which is what makes the r517 case readable from the reason alone
design.vocabulary_is_closed_and_enforced: service._require_reason_detail refuses an empty or unknown subcode/actor rather than recording a useless value - the whole point is that a silent control event cannot come back

surfaces_changed.factory_core/workflow_events.py: GateReason gains subcode + actor; normalize_reason reads both and lifts final_decision
surfaces_changed.factory_core/engine.py: _control_transition takes subcode/actor and writes them into the reason; pause() and resume() accept and forward them
surfaces_changed.factory_core/service.py: pause()/resume() accept and forward them, with the closed vocabularies and the enforcement helper

compatibility.historical_events: unchanged and asserted readable with empty subcode/actor
compatibility.replay: unaffected - the fields are outside the replay patch, so state_hash_after is untouched

next_stage: G3 (old-event replay + reason-envelope compatibility), then S4.2/S4.3 are out of this goal's scope, then S6
open_items: internal pause paths (deadline, freeze boundary, execution scope) still default to OPERATOR; each should pass its own subcode when those paths are next touched
